summary: A quiet-volume week (30 messages) with one loud incident. On Aug 11 Vale found that her paid private 1:1 live had been cut up and sold as PPV — including being sent back to the very fan who had paid for the private conversation. That is the fourth time in 26 days she has had to police how her fans are being handled (Jul 17 scam screenshots, Jul 23 chargeback warning, Aug 1 Shayna misrepresentation, Aug 11 private live resold), and for the second week running the fix was a same-shape 'I spoke to him' from Ollie rather than a written rule for her account. The scheduling backlog also failed to move: Ryan's $600 call was pushed to 'early next week' on Aug 8 and never confirmed, John's $1,800 call has now gone two full weeks without a booking despite her offering 'Friday, anytime', and on Aug 9 she was still asking about missing lives and one open custom — she has now supplied her availability five separate times. Two time-sensitive asks went unanswered: her Aug 7 request for fan notes ahead of the Aug 8 11am OF call (never answered at all) and her Aug 8 question about how to run a private live, which sat ~14 hours until Mayson had to tag Ollie — by then she had solved it herself. No invoice fell inside the window, so no payment risk this week. Mood: still constructive and gracious when apologised to, but she is doing the agency's quality control for it.
